description: Downloads the avatar image of one user. Images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) come back as image content, UTF-8 text files as text, and any other file (PDF, Office, ZIP) as an embedded base64 resource; files over 20 MB are refused. Since avatars are images, this is rarely useful to an agent; for a user's name, email, and other profile data use `getUser`, and to replace the image use `updateAvatar`.

response_format.description: Response detail level. concise removes redundant HTML and JSON:API metadata and may use a small default fieldset on large lists; detailed preserves the complete response. Defaults to detailed.

name: getAvatar
